en: Vintage sepia postcard with two framed photographs bordered by floral decoration. The left image shows a tree‑lined public park or promenade with a path and people walking. The right image shows an early electric tramcar on rails with a few pedestrians nearby, on a street flanked by trees and fences. Below the images there is printed text in Romanian and a long handwritten message in cursive. The overall style is early 20th‑century.
